## Downloads

- **macOS**: the `.dmg`.
- **Linux**: the `.deb` (Debian, Ubuntu) or the `.AppImage`.
- **Android**: the `.apk`. **It needs Android 12 or later**, and won't
  install on Android 11 or earlier. Allow installs from your browser or file
  manager when Android asks.

## Upgrading the desktop app

This release changes the app's identifier to `dev.matthewbpt.headphonebridge`,
so your system treats it as a new app:

- **macOS**: allow Bluetooth again when macOS asks. If it doesn't ask, turn
  Headphone Bridge on in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Bluetooth.
- **macOS and Linux**: Launch at login is off again. Turn it back on in the
  app's window.
